amount_cents.description: None records an explicitly unknown balance, never a zero.

CountyFips.description: Five digits: two state digits followed by three county digits. Never a ZIP.

reference.description: Stable across lifecycle events. Different observations retain the history.

duplicate_ids.description: Exact IDs already present before this import. File-internal duplicates are still counted in duplicates, but their first occurrence is new.

PreviewSummary.description: A preview carries its exact import once, not repeated bill/evidence trees.

bought_on.description: Optional history boundary. Clearing it reveals retained evidence again.

confirmed_at.description: Confirmed by the user against authoritative county parcel evidence.

info.description: Evidence-backed property tax ledger. Bearer authentication or trusted HA ingress. Imports require exact preview hash, If-Match revision and an idempotency key. No payment submission or mark-paid API.
